title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: withdrawal allowance and excess withdrawal fee by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference gives, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the per-cycle allowance of counted withdrawals, the excess withdrawal fee and its per-cycle limit, the withdrawal channels that count toward the allowance, and whether overdraft protection transfers to checking count.

## Definitions

- **Free withdrawals per cycle**: the number of counted withdrawals allowed per statement cycle without an excess withdrawal fee; "unlimited" means there is no limit.
- **Excess withdrawal fee**: the fee for each counted withdrawal beyond the free allowance in a cycle, in USD.
- **Most excess withdrawal fees per cycle**: the most excess withdrawal fees charged in one statement cycle.
- **Counted channels**: the withdrawal channels that count toward the free allowance. Branch and ATM withdrawals never count.
- **Overdraft transfers count**: whether overdraft protection transfers to checking count toward the free allowance.

## Tier table

| Tier | Free withdrawals per cycle | Excess withdrawal fee | Most excess withdrawal fees per cycle | Overdraft transfers count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 6 | USD 10.00 | 6 | yes |
| Statement Savings | 6 | USD 10.00 | 6 | yes |
| Goal Builder Savings | 2 | USD 10.00 | 6 | yes |
| Money Market Account | 6 | USD 15.00 | 6 | yes |
| Premier Money Market | 6 | USD 10.00 | 6 | no |
| Private Client Money Market | unlimited | USD 0.00 | 0 | no |

## Counted channels by tier

| Channel | Starter Savings | Statement Savings | Goal Builder Savings | Money Market Account | Premier Money Market | Private Client Money Market |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online transfer | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts |
| Mobile app transfer | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts |
| Telephone banking transfer | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts |
| ACH debit | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts |
| Money market check | not listed | not listed | not listed | counts | counts | counts |
| Domestic wire | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts | counts |

No tier lists branch withdrawals, ATM withdrawals or internal transfers among its counted channels.

## Points of judgement

**How many counted withdrawals may a Goal Builder Savings account make in one cycle without an excess withdrawal fee?** Two. Goal Builder Savings is the only tier with an allowance of 2.

**Does an overdraft protection transfer from a Premier Money Market account count toward its allowance?** No; that tier reads "no". On Starter Savings, Statement Savings, Goal Builder Savings and Money Market Account it reads "yes".

**Is a Money Market Account charged the same excess withdrawal fee as a Statement Savings account?** No; USD 15.00 against USD 10.00.

**Can a Private Client Money Market account ever incur an excess withdrawal fee?** No. Its allowance is unlimited, its fee is USD 0.00 and its per-cycle limit is 0.
